_comment: Filters offered to the user alongside the metric selection. Same idea as subscriptions.json: add an entry here, save, and it shows up in the web form and is passed through to the metric scripts -- no pipeline changes needed. `applies_to` lists the metric codes the filter is offered for (omit or use ["*"] for all). `type` drives the input control the form renders: categorical (multi-select from `values`), numeric, or date. The entries below mirror the values currently HARDCODED inside the production metric scripts (segment_kratko, segmca, period_type, is_active, reporting year) -- replace/extend them with the real filter set once it's defined.

reporting_year.label: Год отчётности
reporting_year.description: Reporting year. Defaults to the year of the calculation date when not set.
